name: Drawy drawing drawing la
source:
Once upon a time, there was a newb trying to make a Visual novel for a game jam with their team. It was supposed to be "the best VN evaaar!" according to Team leader. But shit hits the fan. Artist got hit by truck. Writer was too busy irl. Friends clashed and quit. And thus project failed. Oh, and said newb dies. 

Once upon another time and pixelated space, there was a butler working for a bickering vampire and his human wife, that was bored out of his mind. But now there's an annoying ghost following him around, telling him he's just a character in an unfinished VN and all day trying to make him "reach the true ending" and "finish drawing all missing assets." And now there's a vampire hunter in town too?

Draw your way out of the story and choose well to help Ghostie reach the true ending and finally RIP!
TLDR:

A VN about failing to make a VN and exploiting the player to finish it instead. 

[From [url=https://arghbulous.itch.io/drawy-drawing-drawing-la] itch[/url]]
translation:
很久很久以前，有个萌新试图和团队一起为游戏创作节做一部视觉小说。按队长的话说，这本来该是“史上最神作的VN！！！”结果状况百出、彻底崩盘：画师被卡车撞了，编剧三次元忙成狗，朋友们闹掰退坑，项目就此宣告流产——哦对了，那个萌新自己也挂了。

在另一个时空的像素空间里，一名替成天斗嘴的吸血鬼与他人类妻子打工的管家正无聊得快要发疯。可如今偏偏有个烦人的幽灵成天缠着他，嚷嚷说他只是一部烂尾视觉小说里的角色，还整天逼着他“达成真结局”、“把所有缺失的美术素材统统画完”。更要命的是，镇上居然还来了个吸血鬼猎人？

靠亲手画画闯出故事困局，谨慎做出选择，帮小幽灵达成真结局、早日安息吧！
太长不看版：

一部讲述“做视觉小说翻车失败，干脆压榨玩家把游戏做完”的视觉小说。
